name: agent-keep-awake
description: Stops your computer from going to sleep while AI agents (Copilot, Claude, Codex, ...) work in VS Code. Zero dependencies, ~0% CPU, uses your OS's own power APIs.
author: apkola29

agentKeepAwake.enabled.markdownDescription: Keep this computer from sleeping (according to `#agentKeepAwake.mode#`). Click the coffee cup in the status bar to switch it on or off.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Keep the machine awake the whole time VS Code is open. Simplest and most reliable.

Keep the machine awake only while something is happening in this window (document or file edits, running terminal commands or tasks) and for `#agentKeepAwake.activityTimeoutMinutes#` minutes afterwards.
agentKeepAwake.mode.markdownDescription: When to keep the machine awake.

agentKeepAwake.activityTimeoutMinutes.markdownDescription: Only used in `activity` mode: how many minutes to stay awake after the last detected activity.

agentKeepAwake.keepDisplayOn.markdownDescription: Also keep the display on. When off (the default) your screen can still turn off and lock as usual while the machine itself stays awake, which uses less power.

agentKeepAwake.showStatusBarItem.markdownDescription: Show the coffee cup indicator in the status bar.

scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:os && npm run test:integration
